summary: Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer with 6+ years of experience architecting resilient cloud infrastructure, automating high-throughput CI/CD pipelines, and driving zero-downtime microservice deployments. Passionate about infrastructure-as-code, observability engineering, and container orchestration across high-scale distributed environments.
Architected and managed multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters on AWS serving 15M+ daily API requests with 99.99% service uptime.
Engineered end-to-end GitOps delivery pipelines using ArgoCD and GitHub Actions, cutting mean deployment lead time from 45 minutes to 4 minutes.
Implemented distributed tracing and custom Grafana alerting with OpenTelemetry, decreasing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) production anomalies by 40%.
Reduced monthly AWS cloud infrastructure spend by 28% through automated Karpenter pod autoscaling and spot instance fleets.
Spearheaded disaster recovery drills and multi-region failover automation, ensuring zero data loss during simulated availability zone outages.
Migrated monolithic legacy services to containerized microservices orchestrated via Terraform and Kubernetes.
Standardized infrastructure-as-code across 12 product teams, writing reusable Terraform modules adopted company-wide.
Designed automated security scanning (Trivy, SonarQube) in pull-request checks, intercepting critical vulnerabilities before staging release.
Maintained and tuned PostgreSQL database clusters, write-ahead replication, and automated snapshot backup policies.
Configured custom Prometheus exporters and log aggregation pipelines handling over 2 TB of daily log volume.

projects.title: KubeGuard: Real-Time Cluster Drift Detection
projects.context: Built an open-source CLI and daemon that monitors Kubernetes clusters in real-time to alert on configuration drift against source Git repositories.
approach: Developed high-concurrency event-monitoring agent in Go using client-go informers and custom admission webhook interceptors.
Integrated Slack and PagerDuty webhook notifications with granular diff previews of drifted resource states.
Packaged lightweight Helm chart and Docker container with minimal 18MB scratch footprint and zero CVE vulnerabilities.
projects.outcome: Acquired 1,200+ GitHub stars and was adopted across several engineering teams as an internal compliance verification tool.

education.degree: B.S. in Computer Science & Distributed Systems
